name: @emsenn/logical-inference-service-section

scripts.check: node --check src/contract-rmn-inference.mjs && node --check src/collect-colony-activity.mjs && node --check scripts/serve-a2a.mjs && node --check test/contract-rmn-inference.test.mjs && node --check test/collect-colony-activity.test.mjs

x-agentic-metro-enterprise.admission: one standard A2A 1.0 Message carrying one canonical outer RMN effect bundle that recursively contains one exact child RMN effect bundle and one A2A 1.0 Agent Card URL
